def: deep or open sea, i.e. the main

occurrences.text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
